description: This Java class `DittoDurationValueValidator` validates header values to ensure they can be parsed into a `DittoDuration`. It throws an exception if parsing fails.

classes.name: DittoDurationValueValidator
classes.description: Singleton validator class that checks if a CharSequence can be parsed into a DittoDuration, extending AbstractHeaderValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided header value by attempting to parse it into a DittoDuration; throws an exception if parsing fails.
